verdict.rationale: FreeAgent is a SaaS accounting product that processes user financial data and ships AI-like features such as Smart Capture and smart categorisation, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair axis to judge it on. The evidence pack contains nothing about AI training data use, opt-out controls, or a data-use policy. OAuth third-party access consent is an adjacent control, not a training opt-out, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
